# Phylo3D-Trait

> Python software for interactive 3D visualization of continuous trait evolution and supplied ancestral-state estimates on phylogenetic trees.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hk20013106/Phylo3D-Trait
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/phylo3d-trait/
Project site: https://hk20013106.github.io/Phylo3D-Trait/
Version: 0.3.2
License: MIT

## Core capabilities
- Read Newick/Nexus phylogenies.
- Read CSV/TSV continuous trait values for tips, internal nodes, and root.
- Render rectangular 3D phylograms.
- Map trait values to Y-axis geometry and continuous color.
- Represent branch-length-derived evolutionary depth on Z; interpret as time only for appropriate dated trees.
- Recommended Four-Layer WebGL2 renderer with fixed four-layer depth peeling.
- Interactive tip/internal-node inspection.
- Standalone HTML plus PNG/hybrid SVG export.

## Non-goals
- No phylogenetic inference.
- No tree dating.
- No ancestral-state reconstruction.
- No sequence analysis.
- No evolutionary model fitting.

## CLI
`python -m phylo3d_trait.cli template-values`
`python -m phylo3d_trait.cli plot`

The current CLI/source is authoritative if copied documentation conflicts with implementation.
